result.reason: The redline properly converts the no-hire into a mutual active-solicitation restriction and includes carve-outs for general advertising, non-targeted recruiter searches, and unsolicited applicants. However, it runs through one year after the Agreement ends rather than 12 months after each individual's involvement ends, so it is broader than the fallback. Replacing “employee” with the broader “personnel” is also unnecessary. The clause therefore does not fully reach the playbook position.
